verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה׀ בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ hin·nêh bā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh bal·lê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: A song of ascents Come bless the LORD all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: EIS aqui, bendizei ao SENHOR todos vós, servos do SENHOR, que assistis na casa do SENHOR todas as noites.

verses.original: שְׂאֽוּ־ יְדֵכֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝בָרֲכוּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.literal: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD
verses.literalPt: Levantai as vossas mãos no santuário, e bendizei ao SENHOR.

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: May the LORD the Maker of heaven and earth bless you from Zion
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR que fez o céu e a terra te abençoe desde Sião.
